description: All-in cost tracking configuration (I2): providers tracked, the 400/500 PLN owner thresholds and provider-native caps/limits. Caps are DATED EVIDENCE from docs/research/alpha-services-runtime-facts.md (checked 2026-09-08), not lifetime prices. Provider caps keep their native units; they are never silently converted to PLN - the PLN thresholds apply to the owner-visible all-in budget only.

budget.behavior: observational alerts only; no automatic product shutdown at 500 PLN

providers.tracks: database/function usage on the current plan
providers.limit: Free-plan hard resource caps (S16 class); Starter allows metered overage, Professional adds log streaming + S256

providers.tracks: Cloudflare Workers Paid baseline + metered usage

providers.limit: after allowances; sleeping behavior affects charges
no provider cap; bounded by the PLN thresholds
Personal: 1 user, 3 datasets, 3 monitors, 30d retention, usage limits

providers.limit: ~2,880 full snapshots/month at the 15-minute schedule; Free/Starter allow at most 2 stored native backups
